follow_up_to.prior_diagnostic: Three coarse-mesh direct Newmark histories completed in memory; the subsequent full-order modal route was refused by the supported aggregate validation-work budget at 108 free DOFs. The fine-mesh direct histories did not run and no direct-history artifacts were serialized.

hypothesis: The requested time-step and axial mesh indicators can be reported reproducibly by running the direct Newmark route alone; omitting the unsupported full-basis modal comparison avoids the identified validation-work-budget refusal without changing the transient mechanical model or direct integration method.

mesh.generation: structured boxes split into six conforming linear tetrahedra per cube; shared midside nodes by unordered endpoint pair
mesh.refinement_scope: longitudinal x only; one cube across each transverse direction is retained

model.mass: consistent TET10 mass assembled by GlobalAssembler
model.boundary_conditions: all UX, UY, UZ fixed on the complete x=0 face

load.type: nodal force at the center node of the x=L face
load.time_function: piecewise-linear triangular pulse, zero at t=0, peak at T1/8, returns to zero at T1/4, then remains zero

reference.spatial_operator: same M and K assembled by GlobalAssembler from the same TET10 model
reference.method: generalized symmetric eigen-decomposition and matrix-exponential propagation on each affine load segment; no Newmark recurrence
reference.duration: two first-mode periods for each mesh
reference.limitations: verifies temporal integration against the semidiscrete model, not TET10 spatial accuracy against a continuum or external solver

observables_and_indicators: tip UZ history at a fixed physical coordinate
RMS and peak absolute error against the full-order semidiscrete oracle
RMS error normalized by oracle peak amplitude
observed time-step refinement orders, descriptive only
first semidiscrete frequency and two-level relative mesh increment
assembled pulse resultant and positive TET corner volumes

criteria.formal_acceptance_thresholds: none; temporal errors, energy variation, frequency increments, and mesh effects are reported descriptively
structural_invariants: the measurement remains at the fixed physical tip-face center
direct solver result status is PASS
criteria.modal_route: not executed in this follow-up; the prior distinct attempt retains its PYTEST_FAILED status

execution.semantics: wall/output limits are enforced by the runner; RSS/process/temp/archive are sampled monitors and not OS quotas
